More on building production systems with AI agents:
https://vibecode.town

content:
10,847 lines of AI-generated code.

5 agents wrote it. 30% failure rate.

I cut it to 3,562 lines. Failure rate: 3%.

Here's what I learned.

The codebase looked fine. Tests passed. CI green.

But 5 agents had each made their own version of the same utility.

3 different date formatters.
2 config parsers.
4 ways to validate input.

The fix wasn't "rewrite everything."

It was: pick ONE implementation per concern.
Delete the rest.
Let the compiler scream.
Fix what breaks.

Went from 10,847 to 3,562 lines.
Failure rate: 30% to 3%.
